_comment: The Pi Durable Platform mark, "Wake" (a 3 x 3 grid of dots on the family's dark tile, the one in the middle larger and fuchsia), as inner SVG markup on the 64 grid, written by `npm run og` from ../pdp-assets/logo/<source>/: `svg` is mark-small.svg, the drawing for 20 to 47 px, used by components/logo.tsx (28 px, header and footer); `svgRegular` is mark.svg, the drawing for 48 px and up, used by scripts/og-image.mjs for the Open Graph card. `placeholder: true` means a neutral stand-in (an outlined square on the family's dark tile) drawn before the logo existed. If the logo changes, run `npm run og` again and commit.
